864-5478-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
864-5478-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Eternal Witness and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Eternal Witness and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.
864-5478-5531-5694-8110.notes:
If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Eternal Witness and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.
An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1671-2167-4548-5721.easyPrerequisites: You control lands that can tap to produce at least {7}{G}{G}{B} (but see notes).
1671-2167-4548-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing each land you control, adding at least {7}{G}{G}{B}.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Takenuma from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Takenuma's channel ability by paying at most {3}{B}, milling three cards and returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Aftermath Analyst by paying {1}{G}.
When Aftermath Analyst enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat
1671-2167-4548-5721.notes: Each legendary creature you control reduces the amount of mana required by {1}, up to a maximum of {3}. Each loop also has a chance to generate more mana than the one before it due to additional milled lands, so if you have excess mana you can begin the loop without the required number of lands and have a chance to achieve the infinite loop through milling.

1525-2031-2406-2660-4264.notablePrerequisites:

1525-2031-2406-2660-4264.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.

Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-4264.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.
